title: Step 4 · Controlled document · draft to point of use · 18.6 s
sub: SOP-118 Rev E on one record: raised from NC-204's root cause, reviewed, signed under Part 11, made effective with Rev D superseded and retraining assigned, then read at point of use on line 2 the next morning.

beats.head: Revision raised (the poster)
beats.text: SOP-118, cleaning validation for coating line 2, revision raised from NC-204's corrective action. In review, 0 of 6, Make effective locked.

beats.head: The redline lands
beats.text: R. Patel, document control: Rev E adds a fixture check on head 2 before each shift. The draft is attached.

beats.head: Reason and redline tick themselves
beats.text: Fixture check on head 2, from NC-204; Rev E draft by R. Patel. 2 of 6.

beats.head: Engineering reviews
beats.text: S. Okafor: the check matches the head 2 fixture drawing. Engineering review ticks live. 3 of 6.

beats.head: Sign, on the checklist
beats.text: D. Fontaine, the SOP's owner, presses Sign on Quality approval.

beats.head: The Part 11 dialog
beats.text: Meaning of signature: Approval, I approve this revision as written.

beats.head: Her credentials
beats.text: User ID dfontaine, password typed. Name, meaning and time kept on the record.

beats.head: Sealed on both sides
beats.text: Signed on Quality approval (Approval · 14:20) and her signature card in the thread. 4 of 6.

beats.head: Make effective unlocks
beats.text: Only with the approval on the record.

beats.head: One current version
beats.text: Rev E Effective from Sep 29, Rev D Superseded. Retraining assigns itself to line 2 operators, due Oct 2. 6 of 6.

beats.head: Next morning, on the line
beats.text: The screen changes: Tue, Sep 29, 06:02, K. Iyer on line 2 has SOP-118 open in the viewer.

beats.head: The controlled copy
beats.text: Rev E Effective and marked as the controlled copy; Rev D shown Superseded; what changed, and his training task.

beats.head: Straight to what changed
beats.text: The page scrolls to 4.3, the fixture check, flagged New in Rev E.

beats.head: Read and understood
beats.text: He moves to the button in his training task.

beats.head: On the record
beats.text: Read at 06:04. Line 2 operators, 1 of 12 read.

beats.head: End at rest
beats.text: The operator's acknowledgment of the current revision. The page holds this 1.5 s, then the first tab starts again.
